meta.description: A self-report map of your inner system in IFS terms: Self, Managers, Firefighters and what they protect.

nav.footer: Transcendent Institute is a school of integrative psychology and self-leadership. This tool is a reflection aid — not therapy, not a quick fix, not a religion. It is not a validated psychometric instrument.

landing.title: Who is leading your inner life right now?
landing.lead: This short questionnaire maps how your inner system is organised at the moment, in the language of Internal Family Systems (IFS): how much Self-leadership is available, which group of parts tends to take the lead, and which parts are most active.
landing.ifs: In IFS the mind is a system of parts around a core Self. Managers protect proactively by organising daily life. Firefighters protect reactively when pain breaks through. Exiles are young parts carrying old burdens, kept out of sight. None of them is bad. Every one of them formed for a reason.
landing.notLabel: You will not get a label. IFS does not type people. You will get a map, and some questions worth bringing to the parts on it.
landing.time: About 10 minutes. 63 short statements. Your results are emailed to you as a PDF and a copy is kept for 6 months; you can delete it from the email.
landing.disclaimer: This is a self-report reflection tool. It is not a validated psychometric instrument and does not assess or identify any condition. It is not therapy and not a substitute for professional support.
landing.program: Transcendent Institute teaches a Self Leadership Program that integrates IFS with Kabbalah, Yoga and Andean tradition. This tool belongs to its second level, Balance. You do not need the program to use the tool.

results.exerciseWhy: This short reflection is for the protector named above, the part that most often takes the lead in your answers. In IFS we begin with protectors, never with the young parts they guard: a protector that feels understood can relax, and only then does the system open. Nothing you write here leaves your device unless you choose to share it.

privacy.heading: Campaign source and partner links
privacy.attribution: If you arrive through a link that names a campaign or a partner (for example a link with ?utm_source= or ?ref= in it), we keep its campaign source, medium, campaign name and partner code in your browser for up to 30 days once you start the map, and store them with your results if you ask us to email them. They are also included in the copy of your results sent to Transcendent Institute, so the school can see where your request came from; a partner code is included only if it belongs to a registered partner. We use them only to count which channels and partners bring people to the map and to know where a request came from. The copy stored with your results is deleted together with them; the copy in the institute's inbox is not removed by the deletion link, but you can ask the institute to delete it. They never contain your answers or your results.
privacy.analytics: We count visits to the public pages of the map (landing page, start, questions, results and privacy pages) and a few steps of the map (landing page viewed, map started, halfway through the statements, map completed, results emailed, program or live-session link clicked) with Vercel Web Analytics, which sets no cookies. A visit records the page address, keeping only the campaign parameters of the link, plus the referring site and general information such as country, browser, operating system and device type. To tell visits apart within a day, Vercel derives an identifier from the request that is discarded after 24 hours. Each step records the language of the page; a link click also records which link it was. Partner codes are not sent to Vercel; they are counted only in our own database (see below). None of it records your name, your email address, your answers or your results. Pages for program participants, facilitators and administrators are not counted.
privacy.partnerCounts: We also keep, in our own database, a daily count of how many maps were started and completed for each partner code; maps started without a partner code are counted together. These counts contain no information about any person.

invite.liveSessionBody: You can also join a free live session, "Reading your map", where a facilitator walks a small group through the map.

partners.title: Partner links
partners.intro: How many people started and completed the map, grouped by the partner code on the link they arrived through. Only registered codes get their own row: maps started without a code are counted under "No partner code", and maps started with a code that is not registered under "Unregistered code". These are counts only: no names, emails or results.
